items.title: A river and a mountain defend, in the resolver and in the scorer that chooses the fight
items.design:
BEN, 2026-09-11: "I would argue we also need a deeper combat system, so that we take into account defence over rivers and mountains, but before this we must ensure we can see strong growth." DEFERRED BY THAT RULING: no sprint until sprint 39's growth items have landed and been read.

WHAT EXISTS. resolve_battle carries a landform defence multiplier on the defender only (mountain strongest, then rift, canyon, crater, highland, valley) and a doctrine mountain_penalty. The campaign scorer never sees the terrain term (battle_trace's own comment: "the term the scorer never sees"), so attackers do not avoid mountains, they lose there. Rivers are absent from the resolver and from the Empires sim entirely; only the migration walk reads them.

DESIGN OWED. Whether a river is a defence term on the region behind it or a crossing cost on the corridor; whether the scorer reads terrain so a campaign routes around a range or over a bridge (BL-917 draws bridges; this is what would make them matter); how it composes with works defence. Written against MILITARY_HISTORY.md sec The resolver when taken up.
